majorChapter: All three cards are Major Arcana, which suggests a significant life chapter. Forces larger than day-to-day choices are at work, so give this reading extra weight.

wands.text: Wands lead this reading, pointing to drive, ambition and creative fire. Energy and initiative are the main currents here.

cups.text: Cups lead this reading, pointing to emotions, relationships and matters of the heart. How you feel matters as much as what you do.

swords.text: Swords lead this reading, pointing to thoughts, decisions and communication. Clear thinking and honest words are the key.

pentacles.text: Pentacles lead this reading, pointing to material matters, work and security. Practical, steady steps are favoured.

reversedBlocks: Two or more of the cards are reversed, which points to internal blocks or delays. Look inward and be patient before pushing for outward change.
